summary.text: Warren Petersen is the Republican nominee, President of the Arizona Senate and a member of the Legislature since first being elected to the House in 2012, according to his campaign site. An attorney and small-business owner from Gilbert, he says he has intervened to defend state laws the current Attorney General declined to defend.

paragraphs.text: Petersen is a lifelong Arizonan and a third-generation Gilbert resident who graduated from Gilbert High School.
He received both his bachelor's degree and his law degree from Arizona State University and works as an attorney and small-business owner.
He has served in the Arizona Legislature since 2012, when he was first elected to the House, and has held leadership roles including House Majority Leader.
He is now Senate President, representing District 14, which covers Gilbert and parts of Queen Creek.
He says that when the current administration declined to defend state laws he stepped in, including multiple wins at the U.S. Supreme Court.
